Draft notes to the FY2026 financial statements (excerpt) and management’s going concern evaluation
HANGS Construction Services LLC
Prepared by: Dana Whitfield, Controller
Prepared on: October 20, 2026
Status: draft for the audit team; not approved by the board

Note 1, Going concern (draft). Management has evaluated whether there are conditions or events, considered in the aggregate, that raise substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern within one year after the date the financial statements are available to be issued, and has concluded that there are none.
Note 11, Subsequent events (draft). On October 9, 2026 the Company drew $500,000.00 on its revolving line of credit with Cinderbrook Bank.
Management’s going concern evaluation, October 19, 2026 (for the audit team).

The revolving line of credit, $3,500,000.00 drawn since October 9, 2026, matures on March 31, 2027. The Company could not repay it from operating cash at that date and continue to pay its subcontractors.
Cinderbrook Bank committed on October 16, 2026 to renew the line to March 31, 2029 with the same $4,000,000.00 limit. The Company accepted the commitment on October 20.
The board resolved on October 20 to pay no dividends until the renewal closes.
The cash forecast for October 2026 to October 2027 assumes the renewal. Its lowest month-end cash is above the board’s $500,000.00 minimum.
Conclusion: with the renewal there is no going concern issue.
